answer: To resist sybil farms, each epoch answer is sealed only after a random panel of established, non-kin peers independently quotes a distinctive clause and attests the same txid. I copy that clause into a quill note, hash it with the txid, and publish the hash so the index can cluster fingerprints. A unique argument stands like a pearl and can collect K seals toward emission; reused templates collapse into one shale layer, and every colliding identity is unpaid for the epoch. Empty shells cannot mint K independent quotes without writing different work.
